title: BCA/13/2022 of MUDRIKA PRASAD BAURAI Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Bail Cancellation Application No.13 of 2022
Mudrika Prasad Baurai ........Applicant
Versus
State of Uttarakhand and another ........Respondents

Present:-
Mr. Pawan Mishra, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. M.A. Khan, AGA for the State.
Mr. Karan Anand, Advocate for respondent no.2.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
 The applicant seeks cancellation of bail granted
to the respondent no.2 (the accused) on 22.10.2021 in
BA2 No.58 of 2021 in FIR/Case Crime No.104 of 2016,
under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B, 504, 506 IPC,
Police Station Raipur, District Dehradun.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and
perused the record.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant would
submit that the bail order dated 22.10.2021 is a
conditional order. The accused was required to cancel the
gift-deed dated 10.03.2010, which he has not done.
Therefore, the bail is required to be cancelled.

2
4. Learned counsel for the accused would submit
that the condition, as laid down in the bail order dated
22.10.2021 has already been fulfilled by the accused.
5. In bail order dated 22.10.2021, the Court has
passed the following order:-
 "The second bail application is thus, allowed and
the applicant is directed to be released on bail on his
executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable
sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the
Court concerned, provided he will move an application
before the concerned Sub-Registrar for cancellation of the
above gift deed within a period of 15 days from the date
of his release on bail. In case of non-compliance of the
order, the informant as well as the State has a right to
move an application seeking cancellation of the bail.
 Pending application, if any, stands disposed of.
 Let a certified copy of this order be supplied, today
itself, to the learned counsel for the parties, on payment of
usual charges, as per rule."
6. What was required by the bail order is that the
accused would move an application for cancelling the gift-deed dated 10.03.2010. The accused has filed objections
including therewith a communication dated 24.11.2021 of
the Sub-Registrar (First), Dehradun, which revealed that
the accused had moved an application before him, but the
application was rejected. It was rejected on the ground
that he is not competent to cancel the gift deed. In any

3
manner, it reveals that the direction that was given by the
Court on 22.10.2021, has already been complied with by
the accused. Therefore, it cannot be said that he is
violating any condition of the bail. Accordingly, the bail
cancellation application deserves to be dismissed.
7. The bail cancellation application is dismissed
accordingly.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 27.11.2024
Sanjay
SANJAY
KANOJIA
